lines.text: The filing cabinet. It is full. Very full. You pull out a folder at random. It says: 'Road Repair,  Main Road Alupotha,  Applications 2007–2024.'

Every application was processed. Every one was forwarded. Every one was received and filed by the next office. The road is not fixed because the budget was reallocated at a level above Nandadasa's jurisdiction. He has known this since 2009.

There is a thinner folder behind the thick one. Personal correspondence. Nandadasa's own letters,  seventeen years of them,  attempting to escalate the issue. He has never mentioned this to anyone. It is not his place.

lines.speaker: Nandadasa Mahaththaya
lines.text: That is my correspondence file. Seventeen years. Everything was done correctly.

lines.speaker: Nandadasa Mahaththaya
lines.text: Would you like to continue with your registration question, or—
He does not finish the sentence. He goes back to stamping. The road file goes back in the cabinet.
